NDT software in Beaumont: what local inspection companies need

The right NDT software in Beaumont handles refinery, chemical-plant and fabrication-shop inspection in one place: technician certificates you can check before a gate pass is requested, instruments with current calibration, method-specific reports that pass owner QA, and invoices that match the client's PO structure. The Atlantis ERP solution does all of that as one system, configured around how your shop already works. Demo and quote on request.

Beaumont anchors the north end of the Golden Triangle, with Port Arthur to the south and Orange to the east, tied together by the Sabine-Neches Waterway. The inspection base here is heavy industry: the ExxonMobil Beaumont refinery, one of the largest in the United States after its 2023 crude expansion, the ExxonMobil chemical and polyethylene plants beside it, the Goodyear Beaumont Chemical Plant, the Port of Beaumont, and a network of fabrication, machine and valve shops that build and repair pressure equipment for those sites. In Orange, the Golden Triangle Polymers cracker built by Chevron Phillips Chemical and QatarEnergy is moving from construction into commissioning and startup, which shifts local NDT demand from new-construction weld inspection toward commissioning support and the first maintenance cycles.

Most Beaumont NDT contractors are regional companies: a shop yard, a few radiography trucks, a mix of conventional and advanced UT technicians, and a Level III who also runs quality. Work swings with the spring and fall turnaround seasons, and fall schedules are always watched against hurricane season. Radiography licensing runs through the Texas Department of State Health Services, owners run OSHA process safety programs, and crews who cross the Sabine River into Louisiana work under that state's radiation program as well. That mix of fixed shop work, plant maintenance, commissioning support and cross-state travel is what the sections below plan for.

Technician certification tracking software for Beaumont plant and shop work

Technician certification tracking software for Beaumont needs to answer one question fast: is this person qualified for this method, at this level, today? In the Atlantis ERP every technician certificate carries scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue and expiry dates, OJT and training hours and attachments, and its status is calculated automatically as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

That matters most in the weeks before a turnaround, when an owner's contractor-qualification group asks for certification packages on every name on your roster. Instead of pulling PDFs from shared drives, your QA lead opens the Expiring Soon menu, sees who drops off inside 90 days, and books renewals or vision tests before the job starts. Vision tests are held as their own records, with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry, so an MT technician with a lapsed colour-perception test is flagged by the system rather than found by an auditor.

The employee NDT profile also holds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which your radiographers need current for the site badge office. Certificates issued under your SNT-TC-1A written practice, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other schemes can all be recorded against the same person, which helps when a Beaumont shop hires technicians who qualified overseas. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days ahead, configurable email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when someone logs hours while their certificate is not valid. See the Certificates app.

Calibration management software for Beaumont instruments and probes

Calibration management software should stop an out-of-calibration flaw detector from leaving the yard. The Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number, with calibration frequency, status and next due date, and Team Assignments warns when equipment assigned to a job is out of calibration.

Beaumont shops tend to run a mixed fleet: older conventional UT sets that stay in the fab shop, phased array units that go into the refinery for weld and corrosion scanning, thickness gauges handed to every turnaround crew, and yokes and UV lamps for MT on rotating equipment. Each calibration record stores provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass/fail/conditional result and next due date, and the calibration certificate register keeps the lab's accreditation number and the PDF with a valid, expiring or expired status and expiry alerts.

The issue/return workflow records who took each instrument, supervisor and manager approval, and condition on the way out and on the way back. Reservations stop two crews claiming the same PAUT unit for overlapping dates. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, magnetic particles and PPE carry reorder levels and a low-stock flag, so the MT/PT cabinet is restocked before the fall season rather than during it. The maintenance log captures probe replacements, firmware updates, cleaning and repairs with condition before and after. More detail at Asset Management.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Golden Triangle jobs

Crew dispatch software for a Beaumont NDT company has to handle overlapping turnarounds, standing shop work and commissioning crews at the same time. Atlantis Team Assignments moves each job through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, and blocks double-booking of technicians and of equipment serial numbers.

Every assignment carries site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates, so the scheduler can see that a crew finishing at the Beaumont refinery on Friday is free for a Monday start at a fabrication yard in Vidor or a unit in Port Arthur. The technician availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable, and overlapping entries are blocked; time off requested by a technician feeds that same availability. Each technician's status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date show in calendar, kanban and list views.

During a turnaround peak the dispatcher can filter by method and level to find who holds PAUT or TOFD and is not already booked, and the system raises a warning if the kit assigned to that crew is out of calibration. Vehicles belong in the plan too: the Fleet app records whether a truck can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and which project and driver it is assigned to, with dates and mileage. See Team Assignments.

NDT reporting software for Beaumont fabricators and plant QA

NDT reporting software in Beaumont has to produce reports that owner QA accepts on the first submission. The Atlantis ERP covers 17 report types, including UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, UT thickness, PMI, hardness, ferrite, PWHT and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence and method-specific fields.

For a fabrication shop building exchangers or piping spools for a refinery, RT reports capture source, technique, IQI type and placement, and weld lines record defect type and orientation for each joint, with WPS, drawing, work order, contract and procedure references attached. For in-plant maintenance, UT thickness readings are logged by direction, and PMI and hardness reports sit alongside them in the same job. Every report runs draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for the third-party or authorized inspector.

Your company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, with logo, header and footer, are versioned, and Excel templates are filled automatically by mapping fields to cells, which helps when an owner insists on its own spreadsheet format. Inside units where signal is weak, the offline field app stores drafts and photos locally, captures an on-screen signature and syncs later. See NDT Reports and Digital Twin Reporting Software; if a client wants indications shown on a 3D model, Atlantis Digital Twins maps them.

Procedure control that stands up to owner audits

Beaumont owners audit their NDT contractors' written procedures, and a proper procedure register keeps that audit short. In the Atlantis ERP each procedure holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the body text or uploaded file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with prepared, reviewed and approved by and the dates; approved revisions are locked, and a rejection records its reason. Full revision history keeps a snapshot of every revision, so when an auditor asks which PT procedure revision was in force on a job last spring, you can show it in a minute. An AI-assisted first draft can speed up writing something new, for example a PAUT procedure for a weld configuration you have not scanned before, but your Level III still reviews and approves it. Approvers get email notifications and reminders for anything waiting on them. See Procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Beaumont contracts

NDT quoting and invoicing software should turn a request from a plant or fab shop into a quote, a job and an invoice without re-typing. In the Atlantis ERP, quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products flagged by method and category, and your branded PDF; the client can accept and sign online, and the quote converts to a sales order.

On the billing side, the invoice header holds the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables. Lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Timesheet hours, split by inspection, travel, standby and setup with a billable flag and rate multiplier for overtime and turnaround shifts, feed the bill, and approved field expenses and per diems are re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across 12 months, which is where a Beaumont owner sees whether the fall season actually paid. See Quotations and Invoicing.

ERP for NDT companies in Beaumont: how the pieces connect

An ERP for NDT companies in Beaumont should connect sales, certification, equipment, dispatch, reporting and billing so every step reuses the same data. The Atlantis ERP is built that way: one record per technician, one per instrument, one per job.

A typical flow looks like this. An enquiry arrives through your website form, or from a business card photographed at an industry event and turned into a CRM lead by the Business Cards app. The lead records service line, NDT service type, industry sector and estimated technicians and days, and gets a lead score from hot to cold. The quote becomes a project with client PO, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, safety induction and work permit fields. Dispatch pulls qualified technicians and calibrated kit, reports come back through the field app, and timesheets drive the invoice. KPI dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring or expired, and issued equipment overdue for return.

If you already use QuickBooks or NetSuite for accounting, or a client wants data sent to SAP or Maximo, the open REST API supports integration with any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Nonconformances in your own process can run through NCR/CAPA workflows configured during implementation.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Beaumont

Implementation is planned around your calendar. For most Beaumont contractors that means going live between turnaround seasons, in early summer or early winter, so technicians learn the field app on shop and routine plant work before the next surge.

  1. Discovery session with your operations and QA leads to map how jobs, reports and billing run today.
  2. Load technician certificates, vision tests and NDT profiles, plus your instrument register and calibration history.
  3. Build your report templates, including owner-specific Excel formats, and your procedure register.
  4. Configure quotations, invoice layout, cost centres and taxes.
  5. Roll out the field app to a pilot crew, then the whole workforce.
  6. Ongoing support from Atlantis NDT, led by an ASNT NDT Level III who has run inspection work himself.

Office and field staff are trained on the system as part of rollout. If your technicians also need ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, the eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator support that. To see how a rollout would look for your shop, ask for a Beaumont implementation plan.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Beaumont

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Beaumont means a system sized for a regional contractor and set up to your workflow, not a package that forces your shop to change. The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with pricing by quote on request.

If you run a small NDT company in Beaumont with a handful of technicians, you can start with certificates, asset management, reports and invoicing and add dispatch, CRM or eLearning later. Contractors with several crews spread across the Golden Triangle usually want the full set from day one. Either way, the next step is simple: book a demo for your Beaumont team or request a quote.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Beaumont inspection company?

The best fit is software that covers certificates, calibration, dispatch, reports and billing together, because refinery and chemical-plant owners check all of them. The Atlantis ERP does this in one system configured for your shop.

Can the ERP produce reports in a refinery owner's own format?

Yes. Versioned Excel, Word, PDF or HTML templates carry your branding, and Excel templates are filled automatically by mapping report fields to cells.

Does it work inside plants with poor signal?

Yes. The offline field app stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs when a connection returns.

Can it track certificates for technicians who qualified outside the US?

Yes. SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes can be recorded against each technician, with automatic expiry status.

Will it connect to our accounting system?

The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How do we get pricing?

Pricing is by quote on request, based on your scope. Send us your requirements and we will come back with a proposal.
